card.name: Unit word after a number, before a noun
card.fires_on: The unit or measure word right after a number or quantity, such as Unit, year, mL, mg, month or week, where a noun like vial, earlier, aliquots or studies comes next. Also quantity words like entire or Little that precede a noun.

modes.label: Hyphenated measure before a noun
modes.description: A number plus a unit used as a describing phrase, where the next word is the thing being measured.
modes.example: venlafaxine hydrochloride extended-release capsules have been shown to be effective in 6<<-month>> clinical studies.

modes.label: Product strength before vial
modes.description: The word Unit after a number in a product size such as 200 Unit vial.

modes.label: Quantity word before a noun
modes.description: A size or amount word in general text that is followed by a plural or mass noun.
modes.example: destroyed<< entire>> swaths of the North Texas town.

card.writes: It lowers the chance of mass nouns like legislation or advice and raises count and portion words like pieces, amounts and batches.
card.plain: It fires on the unit part of a number-plus-unit phrase when a noun is about to follow.
